name: Hotel Haflingerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Haflingerhof is located in the high valley of Wildschönau, in the district of Auffach. The surrounding mountain landscape of the Alpen creates a quiet, rural atmosphere. In winter, the nearby Ski Juwel ski area is a center for skiers. In summer, hiking trails of varying difficulty open up the landscape. The rooms are furnished in a traditional Alpine style. The wellness area has a swimming pool, saunas, and a steam bath. The restaurant offers regional Tiroler cuisine and international dishes. The reception advises on excursion activities and events.
